name: InlineQueryResultCachedDocument
description: Represents a link to a file stored on the Telegram servers. By default, this file will be sent by the user with an optional caption. Alternatively, you can use _input\_message\_content_ to send a message with the specified content instead of the file.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the result, must be _document_

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this result, 1-64 bytes

fields.name: document_file_id
fields.description: A valid file identifier for the file

fields.name: caption
fields.description: Caption of the document to be sent, 0-1024 characters after entities parsing

fields.name: parse_mode
fields.description: Mode for parsing entities in the document caption. See [formatting options](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#formatting-options) for more details.

fields.name: caption_entities
fields.description: List of special entities that appear in the caption, which can be specified instead of _parse\_mode_

fields.name: input_message_content
fields.description: Content of the message to be sent instead of the file
